steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.

title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
summary: Replaces BF16/FP16 KV cache attention with end-to-end NVFP4/MXFP4 decoding, combining dual-residual query quantization, underflow-aware probability scaling, and outlier-aware key quantization with fused transposed-softmax kernels on paged caches. The cost is substantial implementation complexity: accuracy depends on Hadamard rotation, scale search, and static smoothing, while throughput depends on custom FP4 Tensor Core kernels. It can fail on hardware without native FP4 support (the 2.4-3.0x result is B300-specific), on workloads where its quantization assumptions (e.g., RL rollouts, MoE/MLA variants) are untested, or if the fixed-scale error budget exceeds tolerance on domains not in its evaluation.
rationale: The accuracy-preserving FP4 recipe is relevant to long-context serving, but the demonstrated speedups require B300-class FP4 hardware and custom kernels that are unavailable on a single 24 GB GPU, making this worth tracking rather than adopting now.
technique: Native FP4 KV cache decoding via algorithm-system co-design
